description: This file contains localization (i18n) strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin in Swedish (sv). It defines error messages and UI text for the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns Swedish message when result loading fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns Swedish message indicating how many characters to delete when input exceeds maximum.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns Swedish message indicating how many more characters to input when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns Swedish message shown when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns Swedish message indicating maximum number of selectable elements.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns Swedish message indicating no search results found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns Swedish message shown during search operation.
